data: Stabilize income by scanning chains and clearing sites you can actually survive.
Convert blue loot into ISK before hostile activity catches up with you.
Complete class-agnostic objectives for small ISK/readiness boosts without being forced out of a good home.
Upgrade from cheap hull volume into slot-efficient doctrines that can run harder sites with fewer pilots.
Use spare ships and specialists to run multiple timed operations instead of clicking the same answer forever.
Survive 30 days without letting upkeep, ship losses, risk, and low readiness collapse the corp.

data.title: Scan Chain
data.body: Opens a chain if none is mapped. If a chain already exists, scanning extends it for free but exponentially raises chain pressure and can trigger hostile roll-in events.

data.title: Run Site
data.body: You assign a limited fleet and wait for it to clear. Combat sites use combat/support ships, gas sites use one Gas Huffing Fleet, and faction data/relic sites use one Relic Scanner Team.

data.title: Haul Loot
data.body: Converts blue loot into ISK. It does not charge upkeep, but gets dangerous when risk, chain activity, or loot value are high.

data.title: Roll Static
data.body: The fast chain reset. It costs ISK and takes time, but does not advance the day. Completion clears the map, resets pressure/risk, and counts toward the two-roll limit before stand down.

data.title: Stand Down
data.body: Takes half as long as rolling, then collapses the mapped chain, resets risk/pressure and the roll limit, lightly restores readiness, advances a day, and charges upkeep slightly above a normal roll.

data.title: Repair / Resupply
data.body: Restores 20 readiness immediately. It does not lower risk or reset the chain, but it keeps tired crews effective without advancing the day.

data.title: Buy Ships / Upgrades
data.body: Ships add fleet power, hauling, or slot efficiency. Upgrades improve formulas permanently for this run, while repair costs follow the corp's net worth.

data.title: Move Home
data.body: Pay to relocate into a scanned wormhole. Your home class, effect, and statics change, future chains follow the new home, and the move consumes one roll cycle for the day.

data.label: Range
data.text: The visual distance between fleets. Pull Range, Burn Out Of Bubbles, fake retreats, probes, and boosh calls create separation; brawls, tackle, anchors, and drag bubbles collapse it.

data.label: Bubble
data.text: How much tackle and interdiction is shaping the grid. Drag Bubble Reinforcements and Sacrifice Tackle Wing create strong bubble fields; Burn Out Of Bubbles and boosh plays move fleets out of them.

data.label: Pressure
data.text: A quick read on how messy the fight is, mostly from heat and disruption. High pressure means remote repairs and clean execution are under stress.

data.label: Logi Strength
data.text: How intact the repair wing is. Higher logi improves remote repairs and slightly improves mitigation. Split DPS, boosh, cap-chain pressure, and disruption reduce it.

data.label: Position
data.text: Grid quality, warp-ins, and anchor discipline. Higher position improves damage application and can unlock Collapse Hostile Perch. Probe New Warp-In, kiting, and slingshot plays improve it.

data.label: Morale
data.text: Fleet confidence and comms discipline. Higher morale increases damage output; headshots, reserve commits, bad trades, and panic turns lower it. Rally Comms restores it.

data.label: Tempo
data.text: Who is dictating pace. Higher tempo improves damage and helps control range. Mobility calls raise it, while bubbles and brawls often reduce the opponent's tempo.

data.label: Heat
data.text: Overheated modules and repair strain. High heat starts reducing damage output. Overheat Guns and Overheat Logi Chain raise it; normal turns cool it down.

data.label: Disruption
data.text: Electronic pressure, split logistics, cap-chain breaks, and boosh chaos. Higher disruption weakens remote repairs and mitigation. Stabilize Repairs and logi calls reduce it.

strengths: Better at boosh plays and tempo
data.weakness: Sustain suffers if logi gets disrupted.

data.title: Launch TriffView
data.body: Run TriffView.exe. The app appears in your system tray, then opens into the settings screen.

data.title: Enable TriffView
data.body: Click Enable TriffView in settings or the tray menu. Logged in EVE clients are detected automatically.

data.title: Arrange Your Previews
data.body: Drag and resize previews anywhere on your desktop. Use snap and lock controls once the layout feels right.

data.title: Create or Select a Profile
data.body: Set up layouts, labels, colors, hotkeys, and client positions for different activities.

data.title: Bind Hotkeys
data.body: Assign direct character hotkeys or build cycle groups with multiple forward and backward keys.

data.title: Start Multiboxing
data.body: Use hotkeys or click previews to instantly switch clients. Fast, smooth, and reliable.

data.question: Can I import my existing EVE-O or EVE-X setup?
data.answer: Yes. TriffView imports EVE-O Preview and EVE-X Preview JSON settings into a new TriffView profile.

data.question: Why is EVE Settings included?
data.answer: Multiboxing setup is not only preview windows. EVE Settings lets you copy and back up client profiles from the same app.

data.question: What does Fleet Manager do?
data.answer: Fleet Manager uses official EVE SSO and ESI to apply saved wing/squad layouts, move existing fleet members, and invite missing characters. It does not control EVE clients or accept invites for you.

data.question: What are TriffAlerts?
data.answer: TriffAlerts watch live EVE game logs for important events and can flash the affected character's preview, play packaged sounds, or show tray notifications. They do not read memory, inject into EVE, or control the client.

data.question: Does TriffView work on Windows 11?
data.answer: Yes. TriffView is built for modern Windows desktops, including Windows 10 and Windows 11.

data.question: Is it affiliated with CCP Games?
data.answer: No. TriffView and Triff.Tools are independent community tools. EVE Online and related marks belong to CCP hf.
